00158 #define PartConvolve_Docs @param input    The input signal to convolve.                       \
00159               @param impulse    The impulse repsonse to convolve with the @c input.             \
00160               @param startPoint The sample offset into the @c impulse Buffer to use as the first sample   \
00161                         in the convolution (0 is default).                      \
00162               @param endPoint   The sample offset into the @c impulse Buffer to use as the last sample    \
00163                         in the covolution. This is @b exclusive. A value of 0 means all remaining \
00164                         samples in the Buffer will be used (0 is default).              \
00165               @param fftEngine  The FFTEngine to use to do the processing. An FFT size can be specified   \
00166                         here to force a particular FFT size of the processing.  The defualt of 0  \
00167                         will cause PartConvolve to create its own FFTEngine with a size of 4096.  
00168 
00169     
00174 class PartConvolve : public UGen
00175 {
00176 public:
00177   PREDOC(PartConvolve_Docs)
00178   PartConvolve(UGen const& input, Buffer const& impulse, 
00179          long startPoint = 0, 
00180          long endPoint = 0, 
00181          FFTEngine const& fftEngine = 0) throw();
00182   
00183   PartConvolve(UGen const& input, PartBuffer const& impulse) throw();
00184   
00185   PREDOC(PartConvolve_Docs)
00186   static UGen AR(UGen const& input, Buffer const& impulse, 
00187            long startPoint = 0, 
00188            long endPoint = 0, 
00189            FFTEngine const& fftEngine = 0) throw()
00190   {
00191     return PartConvolve(input, impulse, startPoint, endPoint, fftEngine);
00192   }
00193   
00195   static UGen AR(UGen const& input, PartBuffer const& impulse) throw()
00196   {
00197     return PartConvolve(input, impulse);
00198   }
00199 };
